name: Dashboard Navigation
description: Navigate through a dashboard using sidebar menu to reach a specific section and sub-tab, then verify content loads.
intent: Navigate the dashboard sidebar to a specific section and sub-tab

steps.intent: Navigate to the dashboard home page
steps.context_hint: Go to the main dashboard URL or click a 'Dashboard' link
A vertical navigation panel on the left side of the page
steps.verification: Sidebar with navigation links is visible

steps.intent: Click the target section in the sidebar menu
steps.context_hint: A sidebar menu item matching the target section name

steps.intent: Verify the section page has loaded
steps.verification: Section heading or content area matches the expected section

steps.intent: Click the target sub-tab within the section
steps.context_hint: A tab bar or secondary navigation with sub-section tabs

steps.intent: Wait for the sub-tab content to load
steps.verification: The sub-tab content panel is populated with data

steps.intent: Verify the expected content is displayed in the sub-tab
steps.context_hint: Look for tables, charts, or data relevant to the sub-tab
steps.verification: Content area shows data or components matching {{sub_tab_name}}
